A region in the x-y plane is bounded by the curve y=sin⁡x+1x, the x-axis and the lines x=1 and x=π, as shown above. The area of the region is

a
1+ln⁡π+sin⁡1
b
ln⁡π+sin⁡1
c
1+cos⁡1
d
1+ln⁡π+cos⁡1
e
1+ln⁡2π+cos⁡2
